title: The Sunken Grand Piano
summary: An interactive Three.js underwater cenote cathedral where a coral-encrusted grand piano plays an eight-bar D-minor étude with sampled keys.
description: An interactive Three.js / WebGL2 étude and 30-second film. Inside a sunlit limestone cenote cathedral, a submerged concert grand plays an original eight-bar score in D minor as its hammers strike keys, harp wires vibrate, and bubbles rise through sunbeams.
